name: elfparser
description: Parse ELF binaries and resolve DWARF symbol locations.

scripts.install: if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y; . "$HOME/.cargo/env"; fi && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && if ! command -v wasm-bindgen >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --locked; fi
scripts.build:bindings: . "$HOME/.cargo/env" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf lib/wasm && mkdir -p lib/wasm && wasm-bindgen wasm-elf-parser/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm_elf_parser.wasm --out-dir lib/wasm --target nodejs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:bindings && npm run build:typescript
